populationSymbols.W: sorted unique exact authorized document UUID set
populationSymbols.Q: all original selected-document Node and Edge job UUIDs; job_kind and document mismatches retained
populationSymbols.B: exact original batch closure; no recursive graph walk from siblings
populationSymbols.K: exact catalogue-key union derived from W and selected versions; a disagreement refuses authority
populationSymbols.A: exact referenced publication approval UUIDs plus selected-document approvals; malformed source IDs refuse
populationSymbols.M: exact frozen permitted manual alias IDs selected by reviewed alias admission rule; rule remains a finite dispatch decision

intermediateWrites: U03 authority/source/document/queue locks plus exact private C member/first-token/control checkpoint; append only candidate-owned artifacts; no broad relation barrier and no claimed full-origin equality until terminal seal.
